name: Himax Technologies, Inc.
blurb: Himax Technologies is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan, specializing in display imaging processing technologies. Its core business is display driver integrated circuits (ICs) for LCD and OLED panels used in smartphones, tablets, monitors, televisions, and automotive displays, where it holds a leading market share among independent driver IC suppliers. The company also develops non-driver products including wafer-level optics (WLO), liquid crystal on silicon (LCoS) microdisplays for augmented reality headsets, and timing controllers. Major customers include large panel makers such as BOE, Innolux, and AUO.
